2026_04_LAC_SEA.headline: The winless Chargers take a second straight road test against Seattle’s aggressive defense
2026_04_LAC_SEA.paragraph1: Los Angeles is 0-3 and heads to Seattle after Jim Harbaugh emphasized better offensive execution coming out of the Buffalo loss. Rookie safety Genesis Smith’s two interceptions of Josh Allen showed the Chargers can still create defensive momentum. Seattle, however, returns home at 2-1 with a defense capable of generating pressure and forcing mistakes. The Chargers need Justin Herbert protected and the offense on schedule; Seattle’s task is to turn long-yardage situations into the kind of disruptive plays that have defined its best stretches.
2026_04_LAC_SEA.model_rationale: Los Angeles needs cleaner offensive sequencing and protection to unlock Herbert, while Seattle can tilt the matchup by creating pressure and forcing difficult long-yardage decisions.
